thread:
maria: quick thought — should we expose a tiny 'pin hint' in the public API so clients can show which model variant is sticky and the TTL?
kevin: hm, worried about leaking internal rollout labels. what do clients actually need to know?
sophia: mostly: human-friendly name, approximate ttl, and whether it’s a hard pin vs soft preference. nothing that reveals infra ids.
jon: agree. we can make it opt-in and minimal. maybe a compact, opaque blob that clients can decode if they opt in.
maria: opt-in header sounds good. e.g. `X-Redwood-Pin-View: true`. default is off.
kevin: +1 to opt-in. also require teams to request it per-tenant? privacy/security concerns.
sophia: tenant-level opt-in in console + header per-request. console toggle sets a tenant flag, header proves client consent.
jon: encoding idea: a short JSON then base64/urlsafe encode. keep fields stable and versioned, like `{v:1,n:"gpt-mini",t:3600,m:"soft"}` then encode.
maria: can we make it even more compact? prefer TLV-ish string: `v1|n:gpt-mini|t:3600|m:soft` then base64. easier to parse in clients without full JSON lib.
kevin: TLV works but add HMAC or signature? otherwise a client could fake it and confuse UI.
sophia: signature helpful for client-side trust but increases complexity. maybe sign only when the tenant enables a verified view. default is unsigned opaque blob.
jon: agreed. unsigned blob is fine for display-only hints. signed blobs (tenant-managed key) for UI trust/telemetry.
maria: what about backwards compat? if we add `pin_hint` field to the response body, older clients will ignore it. header opt-in means we only add when asked.
kevin: can we add it under a dedicated envelope to avoid name collisions? e.g. `x-redwood: {"pin_hint":"..."}` in response meta.
sophia: Slack-style: keep it simple. add top-level `pin_hint` in response JSON only when header present. document it in API changelog.
jon: small proto/JSON example for the payload:
```json
{"pin_hint":"v1|n:gpt-mini|t:3600|m:soft"}
```
kevin: also need server-side masking: if rollout is using private tags or tenant override, return `pin_hint: "redacted"` or omit entirely.
maria: agreed. policy: if any field would reveal tenant/infra-private ids, redact. fall back to `omitted` vs `redacted`? 
sophia: prefer omit entirely — simpler for clients. but in telemetry we should emit a reason code so ops can debug.
jon: include a small `pin_meta` telemetry header for ops only, not returned to public clients.
deploy-bot: staging: feature-flag `compact-pin-view` toggled ON for org:acme-staging. :rocket:
kevin: nice. also add migration note: clients should not rely on exact TTL; treat it as advisory. tokens can be re-bound earlier.
maria: yep. doc: "pin_hint is advisory, may change without notice, do not use for security decisions."
sophia: UX note — show friendly name + a tiny clock icon and tooltip with "expires ~1h" when present. if missing, show nothing.
jon: follow-ups: 1) RFC blurb for opt-in header + payload shape, 2) console toggle UX copy, 3) add tests for redaction and signed blobs.
maria: i'll draft the RFC blurb and drop a link. thanks all. :thumbsup:
